visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with pigtails wearing a yellow sweatshirt stands in a brightly lit, modern white hallway. She raises her arms above her head, bending her elbows to form a large heart shape with her hands. (2) The scene cuts to a closer shot where the child smiles and pokes her index fingers into her cheeks, squinting her eyes playfully. A hand from the foreground bottom-left enters the frame making a small finger heart gesture. (3) The child then brings her hands to her face, using her thumbs and index fingers to form a small heart near her mouth. She looks at the camera with a curious yet happy expression before shifting to a thumbs-up gesture. (4) The toddler returns to the 'head-heart' gesture, laughing and swaying slightly as she repeats the action. (5) The video ends with a transition to a solid pink graphic background featuring an animated girl character and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A playful piano-based melody begins alongside the high-pitched voice of a toddler exclaiming 'Ai-xin!' with a rising, joyful intonation. An adult female responds with a warm, encouraging tone. (2) The toddler repeats the phrase with bubbling excitement as 'bubble pop' sound effects trigger during visual cuts. The ambient room tone is clean with slight reverb from the hallway setting. (3) The adult voice prompts a final response, and the toddler yells 'Ai-ni!!!' with high arousal and a sharp, positive pitch contour. The music swells slightly in volume during this peak emotional moment. (4) The track concludes with the BGM fading into a soft digital bell chime as the production logo appears.
